title: MeetingRoom
description: A meeting room (ADR-0028, user-requested 2026-10-08, Proposed): a person calls a lead agent and the agents it supervises into the Meeting Hall of a live or finished world, asks them what they did and why, and confirms changes they proposed. The root is the room as tilo-api serves it (GET /v1/worlds/{world_id}/rooms/{room_id}); it is rebuilt from the room's meeting.* events plus the redacted archive records they point at, and holds nothing the events do not. $defs hold the three request bodies and the shapes the meeting.* event data share. Text is plain text: the web shows it as text, never as markup or links. Rules MR-01 to MR-12 are in meeting_room.rules.md.

reason.description: Why the room closed; null exactly while it is open.

mode.description: The person's Quick or Thinking choice for a turn: quick uses the meeting role, thinking the meeting_thinking role (config/models.yaml).

as_role.description: Why the convener may hold this room, from the team store and the world record at the time (MR-03): the world's owner, or an Approver or Member of the world's team whose scope covers every attendee's district. A Viewer never convenes.

adjourn_reason.description: person: the convener closed it; idle: no turn for the configured time; capped: the next turn would pass the room's credit or turn cap; paused: Pause all or Stop all; access_lost: the convener's role or scope no longer covers the room; failed: the room could not go on (writer or archive error).

outcome.description: answered: a reply grounded in the agent's own units; proposed_change: a reply that also proposes a change for the person to confirm; declined: the agent has no record for it, or the safety screen flagged the message; failed: no reply was produced (no text exists).

attendees.description: The agents in the room besides the lead, in seating order.

cited_units.description: Plan units the reply rests on: the replying agent's own units (a lead's: its district's), checked by code against the grounding set (MR-06).

cited_artifacts.description: Pinned artifact versions the reply rests on, made by those units.

proposal.description: A change an agent proposes. It names only WHAT changes (units and artifact versions); its wording is in the reply's archive record. It has no field for an action, a recipient, a connector, a risk tier or a policy: the planner and the policy engine derive those (MR-11).

reply_text.description: A reply's text after the secret redactor; a reply's text is null exactly when its outcome is failed.

turn.description: One turn: what the person asked, the reply (null while it is pending) and the change the person confirmed from it (null if none).

then.description: A failed reply has no text, cites nothing and proposes nothing.

else.description: Any other reply has text. A proposed_change carries its proposal and every other outcome none; answered and proposed_change cite at least one unit of the agent's own (HR-1).

convene_request.description: POST /v1/worlds/{world_id}/rooms. The server picks the run, the role, the caps and the room id.

ask_request.description: POST /v1/worlds/{world_id}/rooms/{room_id}/turns. One turn in flight at a time.

change_request.description: POST /v1/worlds/{world_id}/rooms/{room_id}/changes: the person confirms a proposal, in the proposal's words or their own. Units and artifacts come from the proposal, never from this body (MR-07).
